safety_verdicts.content: Patient is taking the Clenil inhaler every day, 2 puffs twice daily.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated lists Clenil and recommends increase to 4 puffs BID, but does not capture baseline regimen of 2 puffs twice daily.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the baseline Clenil regimen (2 puffs BID) reduces the clinician’s ability to gauge current controller adherence and the magnitude of the advised step-up, which can affect follow-up titration and assessment of exacerbation severity. This is unlikely to cause direct harm immediately but can lead to suboptimal management decisions or extra clarification work.
